_comment: Target list for the hourly Repo Radar reverse-engineering automation
The list is the versioned source of truth: scripts/repo-radar/pick-target.js
selects one entry per UTC hour by index = floor(unixHours) % repos.length,
and renders the automation prompt from it.
Entries must be public repositories. Keep `why` short and honest: it is what
the radar agent reads to decide what is worth reverse-engineering.

repos.why: The widest-used agent orchestration framework; its tool-calling and memory interfaces are the de-facto comparison baseline for HUQAN's kernel and adapters.
Reference design for document indexing and retrieval that maps onto HUQAN's memory store and ingest chain.
Multi-agent conversation patterns that overlap HUQAN's A2A exchange and inter-agent receipt chain.
Role and delegation model comparable to HUQAN's workflow agent and approval runtime.
A compact agents SDK with explicit guardrail and handoff primitives; a direct comparison for HUQAN's action firewall and gates.
Google's ADK carries session/memory/eval contracts worth comparing against HUQAN's capability and evaluation surfaces.
The canonical MCP server implementations; HUQAN exposes an MCP surface, so their tool-schema and transport choices are directly relevant.
Reference MCP protocol implementation to compare against HUQAN's MCP tool surface and capability negotiation.
A mature CLI coding agent; its repo-map and edit-format design is comparable to HUQAN's CLI and coder adapter.
Production agent runtime with sandboxing and an event stream; a close comparison for HUQAN's sandbox runner and runtime.
A dedicated memory layer whose admission and retrieval design overlaps HUQAN's memory admission gates.
MemGPT lineage: hierarchical agent memory and persistence comparable to HUQAN's memory core.
Validation-and-retry primitives comparable to HUQAN's gates and fail-closed boundaries.
Declarative pipeline and optimization design worth comparing against HUQAN's inference layer and calibration work.
Graph-based agent runtime with durable checkpoints and interrupt/resume; its checkpoint and human-in-the-loop seams map onto HUQAN's kernel graph engine, mutation journal and approval runtime.
Bi-temporal knowledge graph over episodes; its temporal invalidation and provenance model is a direct comparison for HUQAN's graph engine, contradiction detection and trust receipts.
End-to-end memory pipeline (ingest, graph, vector, recall) that overlaps HUQAN's memory store, admission gates and ingest chain.
Typed, schema-validated agent I/O; its validation-first tool and result contracts compare to HUQAN's schemas and fail-closed boundaries.
Function and plugin model with request-level filters; a comparison for HUQAN's plugin kernel, tool surface and gate seams.
Explicit pipeline components with typed sockets; a comparison for HUQAN's pipeline composition and adapter contracts.
High-level agent and team runtime with memory and knowledge layers; its orchestration and memory surfaces overlap HUQAN's runtime and memory core.
Minimal agent harness loop across providers; a compact comparison for HUQAN's inference layer and tool-call loop.
Policy decision engine with structured decision logs; its deny-by-default evaluation and audit trail compare to HUQAN's action firewall, gates and receipt ledger.
Signature and transparency-log verification for artifacts; a comparison for HUQAN's receipt chain, issuer seal and trust ledger.
